note: NUXEL v0.7.0-beta live userspace delta. Generated from the same commit as tools/s10plus/a43/package-live.py; staged, SHA-256 verified, atomically installed and rolled back by nuxel-live-deploy.py. No kernel, partition, modem or USB gadget mutation.

groups.component: Nuxel Home, Settings, Maps and the three Tri-Link consoles
groups.health_check: test "$(curl -s -o /dev/null -w '%{http_code}' http://127.0.0.1:8000/pwa/nuxel-home/index.html)" = 200 && test "$(curl -s -o /dev/null -w '%{http_code}' http://127.0.0.1:8000/pwa/nuxel-apps/settings/index.html)" = 200 && test "$(curl -s -o /dev/null -w '%{http_code}' http://127.0.0.1:8000/pwa/nuxel-apps/console/index.html)" = 200 && test "$(curl -s -o /dev/null -w '%{http_code}' http://127.0.0.1:8000/pwa/nuxel-apps/console-usb/index.html)" = 200 && test "$(curl -s -o /dev/null -w '%{http_code}' http://127.0.0.1:8000/pwa/nuxel-apps/console-wifi/index.html)" = 200 && test "$(curl -s -o /dev/null -w '%{http_code}' http://127.0.0.1:8000/pwa/nuxel-apps/maps/index.html)" = 200
groups.rollback: restore every <target>.nuxel-rollback; static files are served per-request

groups.component: nuxel-bridge Bluetooth/location providers and media store
groups.health_check: systemctl is-active nuxel-bridge && busctl --system call org.nuxel.Bridge /org/nuxel/Bridge org.nuxel.Bridge Ping s health | grep -q 'bridge_version' && busctl --system call org.nuxel.Bridge /org/nuxel/Bridge org.nuxel.Bridge BluetoothGetStatus s nuxel-settings | grep -q 'BLOCKED_KERNEL'

systemctl is-active nuxel-http-bridge && curl -fsS http://127.0.0.1:8080/api/v1/health | grep -q 'bridge_version' && curl -fsS -X POST http://127.0.0.1:8080/api/v1/rpc -H 'Content-Type: application/json' -d '{"app_id":"nuxel-settings","namespace":"audio","verb":"status","params":{}}' | grep -q '"cards"' && curl -fsS -X POST http://127.0.0.1:8080/api/v1/rpc -H 'Content-Type: application/json' -d '{"app_id":"nuxel-settings","namespace":"display","verb":"status","params":{}}' | grep -q '"drm_present"'

groups.component: first-party capability grants and hardware config documents
groups.health_check: python3 -c "import json;d=json.load(open('/var/lib/nuxel/permissions/nuxel-settings.json'));assert 'bluetooth:manage' in d and 'location:manage' in d" && python3 -c "import json;json.load(open('/etc/nuxel/gnss/gnss.json'))"

groups.component: systemd version pins and canonical bridge-version documents
groups.declared_reload: systemctl daemon-reload && systemctl restart nuxel-bridge nuxel-http-bridge
groups.health_check: grep -q '^Environment=.*NUXEL_BRIDGE_VERSION=0.7.0-beta' /etc/systemd/system/nuxel-bridge.service && grep -q '^Environment=.*NUXEL_BRIDGE_VERSION=0.7.0-beta' /etc/systemd/system/nuxel-http-bridge.service && grep -q '"host_version": "0.7.0-beta"' /etc/nuxel/bridge-version.json && grep -q '"host_version": "0.7.0-beta"' /usr/share/nuxel/pwa/nuxel-common/bridge-version.json && systemctl show nuxel-bridge.service -p Environment | grep -q 'NUXEL_BRIDGE_VERSION=0.7.0-beta' && systemctl show nuxel-http-bridge.service -p Environment | grep -q 'NUXEL_BRIDGE_VERSION=0.7.0-beta'
groups.rollback: restore every <target>.nuxel-rollback; `systemctl daemon-reload`; restart both bridges
